title: Rule of 72 Calculator
description: Estimate how fast money doubles at any interest rate — or what rate you need to double in a target time.
howto: Enter an annual interest rate to see doubling, tripling and quadrupling times.
Or enter a target number of years to find the required rate.

faqs.a: A mental shortcut: years to double ≈ 72 ÷ annual rate. At 8%, money doubles in about 9 years.
Within a few percent for rates between 4% and 15%. It is an approximation of the exact ln(2)/ln(1+r) formula.

faqs.q: What about the Rule of 114 and 144?
faqs.a: Same idea: 114 ÷ rate ≈ years to triple, 144 ÷ rate ≈ years to quadruple.
